'''Murl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Odionate]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]; in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] he and [[Murl's colleague|another human man]] served as staff members of the [[Odionate cloister]]'s control room on [[Vanahame]] until the redeemed [[Beld Yulan]] killed the other man and forced Murl to shut down the complex.
